person.briefBio:
My research interests center around the theme of helping children and adolescents maximize their achievement and well-being. More specifically I am interested in developing college and career readiness programs, including counseling interventions for elementary and middle school students. These programs are designed to be implemented by school counselors who work in an interdisciplinary fashion with stakeholders including teachers, administrators, and parents. Currently I am involved in a pilot project with a research team to implement a college and career readiness curriculum within a middle school. I plan to continue and expand upon this line of research.

I teach a wide variety of counseling courses including ethics, career counseling, and supervision in addition to school counseling-specific coursework. I imbed the themes of advocacy and diversity in all of my courses as counselors must be able to empower their clients in today’s diverse society. I maintain active involvement in professional associations including ASCA and ACA, and I have held leadership positions within state level counseling organizations. I highly value this professional involvement as it helps me stay up to date with counseling research, evidence-based interventions, and teaching practices.
